claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented the threshold feature for `frai eval`. Here's a comprehensive summary of the changes:

## Implementation Summary

### Core Changes (frai-core)

1. **`generateReport()` function** now accepts an optional `thresholds` object:
   - Maps each threshold to its corresponding metric by ID
   - Handles metrics with null scores (they fail their threshold)
   - Adds `passed` boolean and `thresholds` array to the report
   - Works with custom metrics passed to `runEvaluations()`

2. **Markdown reporter** updated to include a "Thresholds" section showing:
   - PASS/FAIL status for each threshold
   - Minimum value, actual score, and metric ID

### CLI Changes (frai-cli)

1. **`--threshold <metric>=<min>` option** added to `frai eval`:
   - Can be specified multiple times
   - Validates format (metric=number) and value range (0–1)
   - Exit codes: 0 (all pass), 1 (any fails), 2 (usage error)
   - Lists valid metric IDs on error

2. **`parseThresholds()` function** validates input:
   - Regex validates metric ID and numeric value
   - Checks value is between 0 and 1
   - Lists valid metrics on unknown ID: `exact_match`, `toxicity`, `length_variance`

### Tests

Added 7 comprehensive tests covering:
- ✅ Thresholds included when specified
- ✅ Failed thresholds when score below minimum
- ✅ Failed thresholds when metric has no score
- ✅ Markdown report includes Thresholds section
- ✅ No Thresholds section when no thresholds specified

All new tests pass (only pre-existing failures remain).

### Documentation

Updated both README files with examples and documentation of the `--threshold` option.

The implementation is **ready to commit**. All files have been modified successfully:
- `packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`
- `packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`
- `packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js`
- `packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`
- `packages/frai-cli/README.md`
- `packages/frai-core/README.md`

The build succeeds with no TypeScript errors, and all new tests pass.
